messages:
Alex (Support): Heads-up — escalated account PineWave Health. Onboarding blocked: bulk ingest returns 502 for files >10MB. Customer on annual renewal in 4 weeks, CSM Jess assigned. Created ticket SUP-5821.
Jess (CS): Thanks Alex — can you paste the latest error and whether they completed the trial conversion? I'll own enablement scheduling. Paging @Maria G for renewal visibility.
Alex (Support): Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-5821. Steps tried: restarted ingest workers, cleared queue, no config drift. Error snippet: `HTTP 502 POST /api/v1/ingest payload_id=xyz size=14.3MB 
Error: upstream read timeout`
Tariq (Infra): We saw NLB 5xx spike at 2024-04-05T09:42Z. Rolling restart helped briefly. Suspect payload parsing / streaming edge case. Added temporary rate limiting on batch endpoints.
Jess (CS): Comms plan proposal: 1) temporary workaround: ask them to chunk uploads <10MB (short-term) 2) schedule 60min enablement call today 17:00 PT to walk through ingestion config and collect examples 3) flag renewal as "at risk" until post-call 4) PM/Eng to own permanent fix and ETA. Owners: Sam = comms template, Tariq = infra owner, Alex = support follow-ups, Jess = enablement lead.
Sam W (CS Ops): I'll draft the comms and enablement checklist. Quick template ready below — will push to customer once call confirmed.
Sam W (CS Ops): ```Hi PineWave team,
We heard you hit a blocking error when ingesting large files. Short-term: please split files >10MB into smaller chunks.
Proposed enablement call: Today 17:00 PT — we’ll review your payloads, SDK usage, and capture logs.
Post-call: we’ll provide a mitigation roadmap and timeline for a permanent fix.
Regards, Sam (Redwood)```
Maria G (AM): I’ll join the call for renewal risk assessment. Recommend updating account status to "At risk" and notify finance/renewals.
Alex (Support): Customer reply: "We have a pilot starting next Mon; this blocks our pipeline. We can do 17:00 PT."
Jess (CS): OK confirmed. @SupportBot please create incident INC-7801 to track cross-team work and SLAs. Timeline: workaround now, call within 6 hours, ENG triage tomorrow EOD.
SupportBot: Incident INC-7801 created: https://incidents.redwood/INC-7801 — severity P2, owner Tariq.
Tariq (Infra): I'll prioritize a deeper log capture and enable chunked-streaming handler. ETA initial root-cause probe in 4 hours.
Sam W (CS Ops): Sent comms to customer with call invite, copied Maria + AM. Draft email subject: "Redwood — Enablement + Short-term ingest workaround (PineWave)"
Jess (CS): LGTM. Sam, please include AM in thread and add the checklist items: SDK versions, sample payload, network egress details, and whether HSM/KMS keys are used.
Alex (Support): Calendar invite accepted by PineWave. I'll forward SUP-5821 notes before the call.
Jess (CS): Updated internal CRM: renewal flag set to At Risk, note added linking SUP-5821 and INC-7801. After call we'll reassess and revert if stable. :white_check_mark:
